planets.name: K2-255 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-255 with a 1.96-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-255 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-255. Its orbit and size follow Livingston et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.
